$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: Accepting the visual bundle without the v1 prerequisites is invalid

rejection.rule: Accepting generated_visual_guidance_v2 is additionally supported only by the v1 hello capabilities high_resolution_request and sample_image. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.2)
rejection.effect: Acceptance is invalid; the desktop emits protocol_error_v2 unsupported_capability and wire mode does not switch to v2.

summary: The offer advertises both bundles and the acceptance selects both, but the v1 hello did not advertise high_resolution_request or sample_image. Accepting the visual bundle without the v1 prerequisites is invalid.

steps.note: Hello advertises neither high_resolution_request nor sample_image. (PROTOCOL.md)
The visual bundle is accepted, but the v1 hello lacks high_resolution_request and sample_image. Acceptance is invalid. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.2)

outcome: Wire mode remains v1. Generated Visual Guidance cannot begin without the v1 capture and sample-image prerequisites.
